q1_issues.issue: 'left silken threads on the lanterns' deposits the threads unchanged, so the object-change test gives Theme, not Patient — the same threads take Theme under collect / carry / store elsewhere in this parse.
The per-member distribution rule repeats the same mis-assigned Patient role for each nightmoth.
(Ordinal sk_cauldron_1 2 cauldron) fills the scale slot with the entity's own class word, but 'the second cauldron' states no ordering event and no '-est' dimension for that slot.

q2_gaps: Capitalized bare-plural role label ('Keepers lit the lanterns'): the capitalized-common-noun default is declared singular-collective only, and the plural carve-out covers only a label that refers as a name, so a capitalized plural used as an ordinary kind word falls between the two rules.

An ordinal used as a bare identifying label within a fixed set ('the second cauldron', 'the second vat') — no event or dimension is stated to fill Ordinal's scale slot, and the reserved 'unspecified' symbol is licensed only in Measure-family slots.

Bare MASS-noun arguments in episodic clauses ('the lanterns burned mire-essence', 'produced mist-light', 'Mire-essence formed in the second cauldron'): the instruction set states the bare-PLURAL rule (group witness when the set takes part in the occurrence, bare kind filler when non-specific) but gives no mass analog, so the same noun can land on a bare kind or on a witness.

Distributing a transitive predicate whose object is a definite plural group: the per-member rule replicates the whole object group, so 'Keepers lit the lanterns of the East Row' derives that each keeper lit every lantern — there is no object-side under-distribution form ('between them').
notes: Coreference chains, calendar/day-part Time terms, compound decomposition (mire_essence, mist_light, nightmoth, silken_thread, sea_water, clay_vessel), group/cardinality handling and truth values are otherwise clean and consistent across all thirteen sentences. Two borderline calls left unflagged: (Instrument sk_boil_1 sea_water) for the surface 'in sea-water' medium PP (defensible under Instrument's 'substance' licence, though Location/In compete), and the split treatment of bare mass arguments — mire_essence as a bare kind at s2 but sk_mistlight_1 / sk_essence_1 as witnesses at s3 / s11.
